today_in_history_posts.title: Human readable checksum (verification code) to avoid errors on BTC public addresses
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- BTC addresses are error-prone even with technical checksums integrated.
- A 4DC system is proposed to verify transactions and reduce errors.
- This solution could set a precedent for other cryptocurrencies if adopted first by Bitcoin.

today_in_history_posts.title: #zerobasefee
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Advocates suggest setting BOLT#7 fee_base_msat to zero for simpler optimization.
- Proposed changes include a minimum payment size of 5000 sats, altering fee structures.
- Eltoo could reduce, but not eliminate, fixed costs associated with HTLC forwarding.

today_in_history_posts.title: Deflationary money is a Good Thing
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Passive and active investments each have distinctive management styles and goals.
- Issues with passive investment include asset underutilization and the principal/agent problem.
- The article explores potential economic roles for central banks using deflationary currencies like Bitcoin.
